faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our mists, orders, and delivery. Can't find your answer? Reach out — we reply fast.

items.q: What is a scented mist, exactly?
items.a: A scented mist is a lightweight fragrance spray made for both body and hair. It's less concentrated than a traditional perfume, so it layers beautifully without overwhelming, and it's safe for daily use on hair.

items.q: How many fragrances are in the collection?
items.a: Fourteen mists, each built around a distinct mood and color. From the softest morning scents to bolder evening ones, there's a version of you in every bottle.

items.q: How long does the scent last?
items.a: Most customers notice a soft, radiant trail for 4 to 6 hours, longer on hair than on skin. For best results, mist onto clean skin or slightly damp hair.

items.q: Which wilayas do you deliver to?
items.a: We deliver across all 58 wilayas via Stop Desk or Home Delivery. Available options are shown automatically at checkout based on your address.

Delivery fees depend on your wilaya and whether you choose Stop Desk or Home Delivery — the exact fee is calculated and shown at checkout before you confirm your order. Picking up in person at our Algiers or Oran store is always free.
Stop Desk orders typically arrive within 2 to 4 business days. Home delivery may take slightly longer depending on your area.
Yes. Once your order ships, you'll receive tracking details by phone or email so you can follow it every step of the way. You can also reach us directly at 05 41 88 76 10.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We currently accept cash on delivery for all orders, with card payment coming soon.

items.q: Can I pick up my order in store?
items.a: Yes — free store pickup is available in Algiers and Oran. See our Shipping & Pickup page for the full addresses and opening hours.

items.q: Can I get a gift box (coffret)?
items.a: Yes. A coffret always holds exactly 4 bottles. Add 4 or more to your cart and you'll be offered a box in white or black for 800 DA. With more than 4, you can choose how many boxes you want (each still holding exactly 4, in its own color) — anything left over ships without a box.

items.q: How should I store my mist?
items.a: Keep bottles away from direct sunlight and extreme heat. Stored properly, an unopened mist keeps its full character for up to 24 months.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with my order?
items.a: Reach out within 7 days of delivery and our team will make it right, whether that's an exchange or support finding your match.
